Oncology.title: Early Screening & Detection of Nasopharyngeal Cancer
Oncology.whoReport: According to the latest WHO reports, nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) ranks among the highest incident malignancies in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, yet over 70% of cases are diagnosed at late stages.
Oncology.partnership: Our hospital collaborates with health authorities to deploy deep computer-vision AI, empowering clinicians and patients with high-sensitivity preliminary screening from endoscopic images.
Oncology.feature1: Application of a computer vision AI model for automated scanning of high-resolution nasopharyngeal endoscopy images combined with epidemiological investigation and Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV) history.

late_detection.label: Late-stage diagnoses in Vietnam
late_detection.description: Often overlooked as early symptoms mimic common nasopharyngitis.

early_survival.label: 5-year survival rate
early_survival.description: When detected early at the localized stage.

late_survival.label: Survival rate after metastasis
late_survival.description: Prognosis drops sharply with complex, costly treatment.

Kidney.title: Comprehensive Kidney Health Screening & Care
Kidney.subtitle: Harnessing clinical AI to evaluate risks of Chronic Kidney Disease, nephrolithiasis, and nephrotic syndrome from biomarker panels and clinical presentations.

ckd.name: Chronic Kidney Disease
ckd.shortDesc: Gradual decline in glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), progressing quietly over years.
ckd.fullDesc: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) rarely presents overt symptoms during initial stages. Our clinical AI model analyzes serum creatinine, eGFR, and proteinuria to detect early renal impairment.
ckd.feature1: Risk stratification across 5 KDOQI clinical stages
ckd.feature2: Early warning for secondary anemia and renal hypertension
ckd.feature3: Automated dietary recommendations for renal protection
ckd.mockMessage: Male patient, 48 years old. eGFR: 62 mL/min/1.73m² (Mild CKD Stage II). Maintain target BP < 130/80 mmHg and schedule 3-month follow-up.

stone.name: Kidney Stones
stone.shortDesc: Mineral crystal deposits causing acute renal colic and urinary tract obstruction.
stone.fullDesc: Kidney stones develop from mineral metabolic imbalances or chronic dehydration. AI evaluates recurrence likelihood based on 24-hour urinalysis and lifestyle history.
stone.feature1: Early identification of renal colic and microscopic hematuria
stone.feature2: Calculus size assessment and hydronephrosis grading
stone.feature3: Lithotripsy eligibility and medical expulsive therapy guidance
stone.mockMessage: Right lower pole calyx stone 6mm, no hydronephrosis. Recommend fluid intake > 2.5L/day, sodium and oxalate restriction.

nephrotic.name: Nephrotic Syndrome
nephrotic.shortDesc: Massive proteinuria leading to generalized edema and hypoalbuminemia.
nephrotic.fullDesc: Nephrotic syndrome occurs when glomerular podocytes are severely damaged, causing massive protein leakage. Early differential diagnosis between primary and secondary etiology is crucial.
nephrotic.feature1: Continuous tracking of 24h proteinuria and serum albumin
nephrotic.feature2: Venous thromboembolism and infection risk surveillance
nephrotic.feature3: Real-time steroid responsiveness and remission monitoring
nephrotic.mockMessage: Proteinuria 3.8g/24h, Serum Albumin 24g/L. Findings consistent with initial nephrotic syndrome. Forwarded for nephrology grand rounds.

dialysis.name: Dialysis & Transplant
dialysis.shortDesc: Renal replacement modalities sustaining long-term survival in advanced failure.
dialysis.fullDesc: When residual renal capacity drops below 15%, patients require planned vascular access for hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, or evaluation for living/deceased-donor renal transplantation.
dialysis.feature1: Timely vascular access planning (AVF creation) prior to dialysis
dialysis.feature2: Dialysis adequacy optimization and dry-weight management
dialysis.feature3: Integrated coordination with national organ donor registries
dialysis.mockMessage: Arteriovenous fistula (AVF) surgical referral requested for left forearm. Conservative dialytic regimen prepared with potassium regulation.

Cardiology.title: Cardiovascular Risk Screening & ECG Rhythm Analysis
Cardiology.subtitle: Advanced AI models evaluate risks of coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction, arrhythmias, and heart failure from blood pressure, lipid panels, and ECG waveform telemetry.

cad.title: Coronary Artery Disease & Ischemia
cad.desc: Detect arterial stenosis risks, early angina warning signs, and acute myocardial infarction using multi-marker biochemical telemetry and exertional dyspnea tracking.

arrhythmia.title: Arrhythmia & Atrial Fibrillation
arrhythmia.desc: Deep learning models automatically segment P-QRS-T waves on electrocardiograms (ECG), identifying atrial fibrillation, premature ventricular contractions, and stroke risk.

hypertension.title: Hypertension & Heart Failure Progression
hypertension.desc: Longitudinal tracking of systolic/diastolic blood pressure fluctuations, estimating ejection fraction (EF), and predicting left ventricular hypertrophy.

g1.stage: Normal / mild kidney damage with normal eGFR (G1)
recommendations: Maintain a daily intake of 2 - 2.5 litres of water
Have a health check-up every 12 months

g2.stage: Mildly decreased glomerular filtration rate (CKD G2)
recommendations: Keep blood pressure strictly below 130/80 mmHg
Reduce salt intake (under 5g/day) and limit ultra-processed foods
Schedule a follow-up and repeat serum creatinine in 3 - 6 months

g3a.stage: Mild to moderate decrease in filtration rate (CKD G3a)
recommendations: See a nephrologist to identify the underlying cause
Measure the urine albumin/creatinine ratio (ACR) over 24 hours
Adjust doses of medicines cleared by the kidneys

g3b.stage: Moderate to severe decrease in filtration rate (CKD G3b)
recommendations: Get a referral to a nephrologist
Manage complications such as anaemia, metabolic acidosis and bone mineral disorders
Arrange a specialist consultation to plan dialysis or transplantation
Follow a strict potassium, phosphate and protein restricted diet
Renal replacement therapy is indicated (haemodialysis / peritoneal dialysis / transplant)
